response.sql: WITH telescope_stats AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) as telescope_count, AVG(bandusagepct) as avg_bandwidth FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), avg_per_station AS (SELECT AVG(telescope_count) as avg_count FROM telescope_stats) SELECT ts.observstation, ts.avg_bandwidth, ts.telescope_count, ts.telescope_count / aps.avg_count as ratio FROM telescope_stats ts CROSS JOIN avg_per_station aps ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10
